budget-throttle.interpretation: Server writes are not peer receipt. Native callback times and server profile times are separate clocks; durations are reported separately. v7 cancelSource distinguishes the first recorded connection-state failure (1), header receive error (2), or admitted monitor receive error (3); the callback is not the underlying peer decision; no specific TCP flag, OS-internal cancellation decision or AVPlayer penalty timer is proven.
